titleEn: The "chemical messengers" that run the brain
summaryEn: The brain contains billions of nerve cells constantly exchanging information. But between most neurons there are tiny gaps called synapses. To carry information across these gaps, the nervous system uses chemical molecules called neurotransmitters. They are involved in almost every brain activity, from movement, memory and attention to emotion, sleep and the sensation of pain.
openQuestions: Heading vi "Não bộ không được điều khiển bởi 6 hóa chất" trong khi bài trình bày 7 chất (dopamine, serotonin, GABA, glutamate, adrenaline, oxytocin, endorphin). Bản en giữ nguyên "6" theo bản vi; sửa cả hai ở lượt đính chính riêng.
